SanMarzanoTomato.name: San Marzano
SanMarzanoTomato.description: An old Italian plum tomato for sauce. Long, dense, and meaty with little juice.
SanMarzanoTomato_Seed.name: San Marzano Tomato Seeds
SanMarzanoTomato_Seed.description: Plant in summer. Takes 12 days to mature, and produces long, dense, meaty tomatoes with little juice. Great for sauce.
AmishPasteTomato.name: Amish Paste
AmishPasteTomato.description: A fat, heart-shaped paste tomato. Meaty and sweet, it cooks down thick.
AmishPasteTomato_Seed.name: Amish Paste Tomato Seeds
AmishPasteTomato_Seed.description: Plant in summer. Takes 12 days to mature, and produces fat, heart-shaped paste tomatoes. Meaty and sweet, it cooks down thick.
MortgageLifterTomato.name: Mortgage Lifter
MortgageLifterTomato.description: A huge pink beefsteak for slicing. One fat slice can cover a sandwich.
MortgageLifterTomato_Seed.name: Mortgage Lifter Tomato Seeds
MortgageLifterTomato_Seed.description: Plant in summer. Takes 12 days to mature, and produces huge pink beefsteaks for slicing. One fat slice can cover a sandwich.
BlackKrimTomato.name: Black Krim
BlackKrimTomato.description: A popular dark mahogany beefsteak heirloom with green shoulders. Rich-tasting in thick slices.
BlackKrimTomato_Seed.name: Black Krim Tomato Seeds
BlackKrimTomato_Seed.description: Plant in summer. Takes 12 days to mature, and produces dark mahogany beefsteaks with green shoulders. Rich-tasting in thick slices.
PineappleTomato.name: Pineapple Tomato
PineappleTomato.description: A big yellow beefsteak blushed red at the blossom end. The cut fruit is marbled yellow and red.
PineappleTomato_Seed.name: Pineapple Tomato Seeds
PineappleTomato_Seed.description: Plant in summer. Takes 12 days to mature, and produces big yellow beefsteaks blushed red at the blossom end. The cut fruit is marbled yellow and red.
SungoldTomato.name: Sungold
SungoldTomato.description: A modern F1 cherry tomato. Tiny orange fruit in long, grape-like trusses — very sweet, almost like a peach.
SungoldTomato_Seed.name: Sungold Tomato Seeds
SungoldTomato_Seed.description: Plant in summer. Takes 9 days to mature, and produces tiny orange fruit in long, grape-like trusses. Very sweet, almost like a peach.
PeacevineTomato.name: Peacevine
PeacevineTomato.description: A modern open-pollinated red cherry tomato. Small round fruit in dense clusters.
PeacevineTomato_Seed.name: Peacevine Tomato Seeds
PeacevineTomato_Seed.description: Plant in summer. Takes 11 days to mature, and produces fruit in clusters after.
GreenZebraTomato_Seed.name: Green Zebra Tomato Seeds
GreenZebraTomato_Seed.description: Plant in summer. Takes 11 days to mature, and produces small round green-gold tomatoes with dark stripes. Tangy in wedges.
GreenZebraTomato.name: Green Zebra
GreenZebraTomato.description: A modern open-pollinated salad tomato. Green-gold with dark stripes, tangy in wedges.
